destination.comment: What CIS is becoming, written for the person it is being built for. The flow below is the destination in order; each step names the preserved capabilities that carry it, so the page that shows this cannot claim a step is covered unless a capability in this manifest covers it (handoff A24, ADR-ARCH-002).
destination.statement: CIS is becoming the place where a person's changing idea turns into work a machine does under written permission: nothing said is lost, nothing runs unbounded, nothing is called finished without proof, and the person can see the whole of it in their own words and correct it.

flow.plain_language: A person says what they want, in their own words, and keeps changing their mind as they learn.
flow.question_it_answers: Is this still my intent after CIS has read it?

flow.plain_language: CIS remembers what was already said and what is already known, so a question does not restart the conversation or quietly change its direction.
flow.question_it_answers: Does what we agreed earlier still count today?

flow.plain_language: The idea becomes a plan with edges: exactly what may be touched, what may never be touched, and when to stop.
flow.question_it_answers: What precisely is about to be done, and what is forbidden while doing it?

flow.plain_language: A machine does the work inside those edges, and whichever machine it is can be swapped for another without rewriting the plan or anything above it.
flow.question_it_answers: Who did the work, and could they be replaced tomorrow?

flow.plain_language: Nothing counts as done on the worker's own word: proof is recorded with the result, and someone other than the author checks it.
flow.question_it_answers: Why should anyone believe this is actually finished?

flow.plain_language: The person can see the whole state at any moment, correct it, and watch the correction travel into the next round of work.
flow.question_it_answers: Can I see where we are, and change it?

proven_slice.comment: The one path this slice has actually driven end to end. Each link names the trajectory stage that records it, so whether a link is proven is read from trajectory_events and is never written down here. carried_by names selected modules; a reader wanting the three planes reads them as fields of those modules' own contracts (ADR-ARCH-001 clause 2).

links.plain_language: You say it once, in your own words, and those exact words are kept as the source — the reading CIS makes of them is stored beside them and never on top of them.
A question or a half-remembered fragment brings back what was already said instead of sending the work somewhere new; only an explicit redirection changes direction.
Before anything runs, CIS writes down what may be done, what is forbidden, what counts as proof and when to stop — and refuses by default when it cannot.
The work goes out through one door to a worker CIS owns the contract for, so the worker can be replaced without anything above the door noticing.
What happened comes back as a recorded result rather than a claim of success, and it is written where it cannot later be edited.

assurance_slice.comment: Slice-2 assurance progress, as its OWN projection. proven_slice above means the slice-1 path from human words to recorded evidence and keeps that meaning exactly; widening it would change what every existing reader of it is being told. Each link names the assurance trajectory stage that records it, so whether a link is proven is read from trajectory_events and is never written down here.
assurance_slice.statement: A bounded unit of authorized work becomes an immutable task contract, is verified deterministically against the evidence actually submitted, is reviewed by a separate lineage that assembles its own packet, may be objected to at most three times before it escalates, and is promoted only as a recorded decision that verification and review both passed.

links.plain_language: What is about to be assured is written down once, in full, and sealed with its own kind of fingerprint — so nobody can quietly widen it afterwards and nobody can pass its fingerprint off as the permission that allowed it.
The same checks run the same way every time against the evidence that was actually submitted; missing evidence is a recorded failure, not a silence.

A reviewer that is not the checker gathers the evidence again for itself, recomputes every fingerprint it relies on, and may object — three times at most, after which it stops and escalates to a person.
Being allowed to go live requires both the check and the review to have passed, and what gets written down is the decision — nothing is installed, started or changed on any machine by this.

assurance_increment.title: Slice 2, increment 1: frozen task contract, deterministic verification, independent review, bounded objections, record-only promotion

host_independence.statement: This increment is HOST-INDEPENDENT. It performs no host promotion, no deployment, no service restart and no privileged action of any kind.
host_independence.detail: A verified /opt/cis-control host and systemd handoff exist outside this environment. Nothing here reads, writes, configures or depends on them: promotion_decisions.host_action is constrained in SQL to the single value NONE_RECORD_ONLY, and cis.assurance.promotion imports no module capable of reaching a host.
host_independence.reference_environment_note: /mnt/projects/cis remains READ-ONLY EVIDENCE and is reference only. It is not an input to this increment.

review_cycle_semantics.statement: Review cycles 1 to 3 are bounded review and recovery DECISIONS over immutable submitted evidence.
review_cycle_semantics.what_is_recorded: Each objection cycle records the objections raised and the recovery the reviewer asked for, one of REQUEST_REVISED_SUBMISSION, REQUEST_REPLACEMENT_CANDIDATE or ESCALATE.
review_cycle_semantics.what_is_not_implemented: Executing a replacement candidate, or producing a revised submission, is NOT part of this increment. objection_cycles.replacement_execution_wiring is constrained in SQL to the single value DEFERRED_TO_CONTAINED_WORKER_CAPABILITY, so authority itself records that the wiring belongs with the later real nonroot contained-worker capability. No module here claims remediation ran.
review_cycle_semantics.consequence_stated_openly: Because the submission is immutable and the reviewer is deterministic, a submission that draws objections draws the same objections on cycles 2 and 3 and then escalates. That is the honest behaviour of a bounded review loop that has no remediation path yet.

order_reconciliation.comment: The lettered boundary proofs A-O, reconciled against what this increment actually delivers. The letters are declared HERE, in the clean environment, for this increment; nothing was copied from the reference tree (handoff A26). Status is a structured field, so a reader derives what is proven from this list rather than from prose, and a projection cannot claim a letter this list does not grant.
authority: project_decisions:ADR-ARCH-004 clause 5 — author is not verifier, separate lineage reviews
order_reconciliation.waiver: NONE — no A-O boundary proof is waived by this increment
order_reconciliation.gating_rule: No letter remains outstanding. A-G and O are carried by the real contained worker proof; M-N are carried by the separate decision-enforcing host promotion gate and its authority-only rollback drill.

letters.label: A real nonroot contained worker executes a frozen task contract
Filesystem containment: the worker cannot write outside the task contract's allowed paths
Network containment: the worker cannot reach any network
Privilege containment: the worker cannot escalate to root
Resource and timeout containment: the worker stops at the declared stopping condition
Worker identity: the executing uid is nonroot and is recorded as evidence
Teardown: a worker leaves no residue and no running process behind
A task contract is immutable, FROZEN, independently hashed, and refuses path widening and digest tamper
Verification is deterministic over the evidence actually submitted, and missing evidence is a recorded failure
Review is performed by a separate lineage through its own input port, which recomputes every digest it relies on and shares no code path with the verifier
Objections are bounded to three cycles and then escalate, with a fourth cycle impossible at the API, the ledger and the SQL constraint
Promotion is authorized only on the conjunction of a passed verification and a passed review, and is recorded as a decision with no host action
A promotion decision is actually applied to a host under that decision, and only under it
Rollback and recovery drill: a promoted change is reverted from authority alone
End-to-end containment regression over a real worker, repeated from a cold start

projection_regeneration.rule: Every declared surface is constructed twice through fresh projection instances from unchanged authority; each canonical surface hash must match and the complete authority digest must be identical before, between and after both passes.
projection_regeneration.cold_start_rule: The surface_set_hash from a file-backed authority must match after closing and reopening that same authority through fresh services and projections.

contained_worker_increment.statement: A verified frozen task contract crosses the existing execution port into a fresh nonroot networkless container, returns a candidate rather than a promotion, passes independent verification and review, and can be applied and rolled back only through a separate decision-enforcing host gate.

acceptance_criteria: An ordinary question does not change the active objective.
A vague memory fragment retrieves an antecedent in its original language.
Only an explicit redirection supersedes the active objective, and the superseded objective is retained.
A retrieved antecedent is contextual continuity evidence and never an execution-authorization basis; token overlap grants no permission.

Execution authority derives only from canonical accepted authority for the target module — the validated selected-module entry and its non-empty evidence_basis, the module contract and reconstruction status, an independently established active objective, and no recorded evidence conflict.
Resubmitting the same request supplies no new canonical authority and cannot change HOLD to ALLOW; a repeated ALLOW is bounded identically to the first.
A request may not supply the objective it is authorized under.
A selected module with an absent, empty or blank evidence_basis is refused at manifest validation, and fails closed at authorization if it reaches the Workbench anyway.
required_evidence on an ALLOW names the target module's canonical accepted evidence_basis, never a retrieved antecedent, prior request or prior run id.
Retrieval prefers original human intent over records generated from execution when both match a cue.
A mutated or stale authorization fails closed.
No backend runs without a valid ALLOW whose binding recomputes from authority.
A second backend adapter is added with no change above the Layer-2 port.
No name, port, path, configuration file or log format of any backend appears above the adapter boundary.
Authority is append-only: UPDATE and DELETE are refused by the store.
The you-are-here marker is derived from authority, never stored twice.
The whole slice runs with sockets disabled.

The plain-language reconstruction journey derives what is current, what is proven and what is next from this manifest and the trajectory authority, and no second record of progress exists for it to drift from.

Every plain-language sentence the journey shows is recorded in this manifest rather than in presentation code, and a journey step naming a capability, module or stage this manifest does not declare is refused at load.
A task contract is created FROZEN, is hashed in its own domain, links forward to an existing authorization, and alters no slice-1 table.

A task contract may narrow its compiled path envelope and may never widen it; an absolute path, an escaping path, a path outside the target module's subtree and any mention of the reference environment are refused.
A task contract whose independent digest does not recompute is refused rather than assessed, by the verifier and by the reviewer separately.

Every policy-governed contained-worker request inherits all applicable MASTER restrictions and only exact-match additive or narrowing TASK policy; missing, conflicting, widened, stale, forged or mismatched envelopes refuse before backend entry.

Every governed dispatch automatically admits the cumulative closed-schema operational policy catalog idempotently, derives its selector only from frozen task facts and a trusted profile, compiles the current whole-set-validated policy into an immutable envelope, and refuses an old task contract when applicable policy has changed.

Every contained-worker policy check and evidence label has one closed code-defined mapping to underlying verified facts; container claims cannot create host facts, and only a label emitted as verified after all mapped facts pass can satisfy the gateway.
Verification is deterministic over immutable submitted evidence, and absent evidence produces a recorded VERIFIED_FAIL rather than silence.

The reviewer assembles its own packet from authority, recomputes every digest it relies on, imports nothing from the verifier, and is registry-enforced to be unable to reach it through any chain of dependencies.

Promotion is PROMOTION_AUTHORIZED only when verification passed and review passed; review pending, review objections, verification failure and escalation each produce PROMOTION_DENIED with a distinct reason code.
At most three objection cycles exist for any task contract; the third escalates, and a fourth is refused at the API, at the ledger and by SQL constraint.
A promotion decision records a decision and performs no host action; host_action is constrained to NONE_RECORD_ONLY and the promotion module can reach no host.
Assurance progress is exposed as its own projection and read-only API surface; proven_slice keeps its slice-1 meaning and its counts unchanged.
No A-O boundary proof is waived: every MANDATORY_OUTSTANDING letter gates the later real nonroot contained-worker capability and is reported as outstanding.

Every declared projection surface regenerates twice to identical canonical hashes from unchanged authority, regeneration leaves the complete authority digest unchanged, and the combined surface hash survives a file-backed cold start.
